newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-COLE SET FOR CHRISTMAS RETURN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COLE SET FOR CHRISTMAS RETURN.

text.p: Andy Cole is poised for a return to first-team action after playing all 90 minutes for Manchester United reserves and scoring the opening goal in a 2-2 draw against Derby reserves on Monday.
Cole was on target after 29 minutes, showing he had lost none of his goal-scoring skills despite being sidelined since the start of the season.
The seven million pounds ($11.55 million) striker was struck down with pneumonia during the summer then broke both shins in a reserve game at Anfield in October.

Now Cole is close to a senior comeback with manager Alex Ferguson hinting that his next appearance will be on the substitutes bench for one of the holiday games _ possibly the December 26 fixture at Nottingham Forest.
"It was a good game for him and I was able to monitor how he has done," said Ferguson.
"I don't see any point in waiting until January 8 for the next reserve game so he will probably be a substitute soon."
